firstMismatch.cEntry: pickup.c:in_container calls freeinv; invent.c:freeinv_core cancels the timed figurine’s FIG_TRANSFORM before it is added to the container
firstMismatch.jsEntry: pickup.js:in_container calls freeinv without the required stopFigurineTimer hook, so freeinv_core throws before the put-in message

summary: The session stashes a cursed timed figurine into a bag. C pickup.c:in_container removes it with freeinv; invent.c:freeinv_core stops FIG_TRANSFORM before it is added to the container. JS freeinv_core already implements that operation through stopFigurineTimer, but the in_container caller had supplied only { state }. The caller now provides the hook backed by timeout.js:stop_timer(FIG_TRANSFORM,...), so the timer is canceled before insertion. The full admitted replay matches every screen, RNG call, and cursor through the later #timeout check.

source.branch: After validation and fit checks, in_container calls freeinv before burning, billing, icebox, bag-of-holding, and insertion work. The freeinv call reaches invent.c:freeinv_core; for obj->otyp == FIGURINE && obj->timed, C calls stop_timer(FIG_TRANSFORM,obj_to_any(obj)) and discards its result. The timer is canceled before the successful put-in message.
callers: pickup.c:use_container obtains the selected stash item and calls in_container.
pickup.c:in_container calls invent.c:freeinv; invent.c:freeinv calls freeinv_core before container insertion.
JS pickup.js:use_container calls in_container; JS pickup.js:in_container calls invent.js:freeinv, whose existing freeinv_core requires stopFigurineTimer for a timed figurine.

evidence: The published v75 admission evaluation at source base abc60e89302029bc1f415e6eb8709cbea7454144 records 310/393 screens, 2114/2117 RNG calls, and 310/393 cursors, with null error.

The admitted recording segment 0 reaches stash item selection at step 309 and selects the cursed figurine at step 310. C outputs “You put a figurine of a newt into the bag.” after the timed figurine leaves inventory.

C pickup.c:in_container calls freeinv before adding the item; invent.c:freeinv_core stops FIG_TRANSFORM for a timed figurine. JS pickup.js:in_container calls freeinv(obj,{state}), while JS invent.js:freeinv_core requires a stopFigurineTimer hook and rejects the missing hook before completing the stash.

After the caller correction, the admitted v75 recording segment 0 matches completely through step 392: 393/393 screens, 2117/2117 RNG calls, 393/393 cursors, null error, and no unported calls. The later timeout check also matches, confirming that the canceled FIG_TRANSFORM does not retry.
